summary.text: Saima Chase, also known as Ikrik, is the Democratic candidate for the Alaska House of Representatives, District 40, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the August 18 primary.
She also ran for the seat in 2024, receiving 28.5 percent of the vote in a race won by Robyn Frier.
